cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take the wedding-hall key off that teacup and put it on the invitation. I want everything for opening up in one place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The key's fallen in. I'll dry it with the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop rubbing; the paper's coming apart around the teeth. Hold the cup under it while I pick the wet bits off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The key's slipped back in, and the invitation's just pulp now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then carry the cup to the hall. I'll sort the key out on the doorstep. We were taking a key and an invitation; now we're arriving with a cup of both. Keep it level.
